title: Non-Esterified Fatty Acids Measurement Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yutfwwn

steps.title: Reconstitute Color Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the color reagents by reconstituting them with their respective solvents.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute Color Reagent A with 50 ml of Solvent A.
Reconstitute Color Reagent B with Solvent B.

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Calibrator
steps.instruction: Add 5 μl of calibrator and sample to each well.

steps.title: Perform First Incubation
steps.instruction: Add Reagent A to the wells and measure absorbance, ensuring no bubbles are introduced during dispensing to avoid interference with the plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μl of Reagent A to each well.

steps.title: Perform Second Incubation
steps.instruction: Add Reagent B to the wells and measure absorbance.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μl of Reagent B to each well.

steps.title: Calculate Fatty Acid Concentration
steps.instruction: Process the absorbance readings to determine the concentration of unknown samples.

substeps.instruction: Subtract blank readings from final readings.
Calculate unknown samples using the formula: (Sample Absorbance ÷ Calibrator Absorbance) × Calibrator Concentration.
